this_title: What Is This Film Called Love
introduction: In Mexico, with only three days and a budget of £10, Mark Cousins (The Story of Film: An Odyssey) managed to come up with a poetic documentary examining the essence of happiness. This playful and intimate ode to freedom of movement, creativity and trust in one’s own instincts is distinctive for its special connection with the experiences and ideas of Sergei Eisenstein, and the work of Chris Marker and Virginia Woolf.
